name: Explore Bharat Safar — Cloudflare Enterprise WAF Ruleset
description: OWASP Core Ruleset, rate limiting, and DDoS mitigation rules

rules.expression: (http.request.uri.query contains "union select" or http.request.uri.query contains "--" or http.request.body.raw contains "' OR '1'='1")
(http.request.uri.query contains "<script>" or http.request.body.raw contains "javascript:" or http.request.body.raw contains "onerror=")
(http.request.uri.path contains "../" or http.request.uri.path contains "..%2f" or http.request.uri.path contains "/etc/passwd")
rules.description: Block Path Traversal & Local File Inclusion (LFI)
Rate Limit Authentication & OTP Endpoints (10 req/min per IP)
Rate Limit Public Search Ingress (150 req/min per IP)
Challenge Malicious Scrapers & Automated Bot Networks
